title: noccaea procumbens proles tournefortii
intro: Noccaea procumbens proles tournefortii, commonly known as  Tournefort's rockcress or Alpine penny-cress, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The health benefits of Tournefort's rockcress are attributed to its ability to alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, and to its potential to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Noccaea procumbens proles tournefortii include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
